title: Granting a Coverage Year's Allowance Late on a Plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
Where the allowance for a coverage year on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is granted well after the anniversary of the day coverage began, the grant is taken at a share rather than in full.

Where the whole months since the anniversary of the day coverage began stand above 5, the grant is taken at 70 percent. Where those whole months stand above 2 but not above 5, the grant is taken at 85 percent. In any other case the grant is taken whole and unreduced.

## Where the months fall

| Whole months since the anniversary of the day coverage began | The share the grant is taken at |
|---|---|
| more than 5 | 70 percent |
| more than 2, and 5 or fewer | 85 percent |
| 2 or fewer | the whole grant, unreduced |

The whole months in question are those the coverage year in progress has run, counted from the anniversary of the day coverage began to the handling date.

## Boundary readings

At exactly 2 whole months since the anniversary the grant is taken whole, because that reading requires more than 2. At 3 whole months it is taken at 85 percent. At exactly 5 whole months it is still taken at 85 percent, because the 70 percent reading requires more than 5; at 6 whole months it is taken at 70 percent.
